steps.caption: This is croft. A file opens in a tab, highlighted, with a language server behind it. Esc leaves the tour at any time.
{mod}+P finds any file by a few letters of its name. 'app' is typed for you: Enter opens app.py.
View: Split Editor, in the command palette, puts two files side by side.
Ctrl+J opens a real terminal inside croft. It runs your shell, in this folder.
Commands run right here. This one checks app.py, and it has a mistake in it.
croft reads the error in the terminal and takes you to the line. {mod}+click does the same on any file:line you see.
{mod}+Shift+P is the command palette, every command searchable. Enter opens the theme picker; pick with the arrows, Enter keeps it.
That is the tour. Press Enter to finish; the sample project is removed and you are back in croft.
